cfg_comparison.candidate_vs_retail: not address-comparable. Candidate block/edge counts above differ from retail; the compared structural properties are listed under compared_properties.

compared_properties: CreateMutexA(NULL, TRUE, pointer to bytes 49 47 49 4d 55 54 45 58 at 0x00541ECC)
NULL-handle branch to shared failure block
GetLastError() == 0xB7 branch to shared failure block
second GetLastError() == 6 branch to shared failure block
MessageBoxA(NULL, "IGI is already running.", "Error", 0x10) then return 0 with no CloseHandle/ReleaseMutex
divergences: Candidate Main is cdecl and takes RetailMainConfig*, while retail is __stdcall(HINSTANCE, int) with ret 0x10.
Candidate window shell uses WNDCLASSEXW/RegisterClassExW/CreateWindowExW; retail uses WNDCLASSA/RegisterClassA/CreateWindowExA.

Retail does not test RegisterClassA; candidate returns 1 on RegisterClassExW failure. Retail shows MessageBoxA(NULL, "Couldn't open window", "Innerloop", MB_ICONERROR) and returns 0 on CreateWindowExA failure; candidate returns 1 without a box.
Retail normal teardown also calls SetForegroundWindow, UnregisterClassA and CoUninitialize; candidate does not.
Retail can return the WM_QUIT wParam stored at [esp+0x14] (0x0048F8A3); candidate returns 0.
Candidate CFG: 22 blocks / 31 edges at 0x0041FB60 versus retail 26 blocks / 37 edges. Only the mutex prefix and failure block were compared structurally.
limitations: The candidate mutex prefix was compared instruction-by-instruction. The remainder of Main is a host adaptation and was not claimed equivalent.
Binary Ninja and radare2 CFG scores are retail-image structure only. They do not measure candidate equivalence.
angr CFGFast is approximate and splits blocks differently; only the exact entry and unresolved-jump result are used as evidence.
No paired retail/candidate runtime capture exists for this native, so no behavioral equivalence is claimed.
